title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E06 — Sustainable Grass, Driveway Lights
Jenn visits a Rhode Island sod farm to see what sustainable grass alternatives they've been experimenting with; Tom and Kevin discuss the most common types of nailhead and shank designs; Heath brightens up a dark driveway.

title: This Old House
description:
S43 E36 — Saratoga Springs: Watertight Doghouse Dormers
Running new water and sewer lines; the house is brought up to code with fire sprinklers; doghouse dormers are made watertight.

title: This Old House
description:
S43 E37 — Saratoga Springs: Smooth Finish
Installing a low-impact automatic irrigation system; flooring; the ICF foundation gets a stucco-like finish.

title: This Old House
description:
S43 E38 — Saratoga Springs: Pantry Problems
Installing cabinetry in the pantry; the homeowners prepare and paint the exterior PVC trim.

title: This Old House
description:
S43 E39 — Saratoga Springs: A Legacy Restored
It's a wrap on the multigenerational 1864 Dutch Colonial, now a two-family with an open floor plan.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E01 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: Welcome to Atlanta
The crew travels to Atlanta to begin work on an 1890s Victorian.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E02 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: Unsafe Structures
Unsafe structures are uncovered and demolished; building a lending library; saving an oak tree.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E03 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: School of HVAC
Touring the Atlanta BeltLine; replacing the existing footings with a stem wall; adding a vapor barrier to a crawl space; a lesson on HVAC installation; touring an outdoor learning center.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E04 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: Cardboard Kitchen
Putting up new framing; installing ductwork; exploring native fruit trees; cardboard boxes make for a real kitchen feel; restoring old windows.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E05 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: Whole House Protection
Progress is made on the interior and exterior of the house; bevel pine siding is woven into the old; touring Tyler Perry Studios; adding lightning and surge protection; the Dracut Centre School restoration is completed.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E06 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: Respecting the Old
The old details of the home are respected; new porch columns are made to match the old; a bathroom gets a concrete-like finish; installing a reclaimed front door; visiting Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.'s birth home.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E07 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: Repointed and Planted
Planting a medicinal garden; cleaning and preparing the front door for paint; repairing the front steps; installing a water heater; building custom shelves; installing wallpaper.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E08 — Atlanta Postmaster's House: Families Meet
The renovation of the 1890s Victorian is completed; the family of the former owner meets the homeowners; touring the new spaces; mounting the lending library.

title: This Old House
description:
S44 E09 — Newburyport Forever House: Shipwrights and Captains
A new project begins in the middle-class town of Newburyport, Mass.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E08 — Regrade Lawn; Solid Core Doors
Regrading a backyard to improve the lawn's health; houseplants that thrive at any light level; upgrading hollow-core doors to solid-core doors.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E09 — Garage Storage; Anode Rod
Installing an overhead storage rack; how to upgrade a 3-way smart switch; how to extend the life of a tank-style water heater by replacing the anode rod.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E10 — Idaho Backyard Makeover
Redesigning a backyard for a homeowner who hosts large dinner parties; replacing two rusted window wells.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E11 — Speakeasy Hidden Door
Using a toilet flange repair kit; essential upkeep to ensure a gas mower runs like new; installing a hidden door.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E12 — Paint Ceiling; Squeaky Floor
Repainting a damaged ceiling; utility energy meters; comparing vinyl, wood and fiber-cement siding; how to stop hardwood floor squeaks with a clever DIY fix.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E13 — Split Water Heater; Attic Ladder
Upgrading a home to a solar-assisted split heat pump water heater; three common houseplant pests and simple tricks to banish them; installing an attic ladder.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E14 — 3-Way Switch; Split Rail Fence
Cleaning up paint when it spills on the floor; how 3-way switches work and common wiring mistakes; installing a classic wooden split rail fence.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E15 — Toys and Color; Air Switch
Common types of caulks and sealants; installing a garbage disposal with an air switch controller; building a children's dress-up closet.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E16 — Grass Seed Facility; Porch Swing
How turfgrass seed is harvested and cleaned; breaking down popular paver types and walkway patterns; installing a porch swing.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E17 — Lead Testing; Hillside Steps
Preventing sink drain clogs; how to test for lead-based paint; installing granite hillside steps.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E18 — NOLA Shutters; Hardwired Alarms
Upgrading shutters in a historic New Orleans neighborhood; how to read fertilizer labels and choose between organic and synthetic options; upgrading battery-operated smoke detectors to a hardwired combo alarm system.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E19 — Arch Accent; Pea Stone Patio
Painting an arch accent wall in a nursery; debunking plant myths; installing a pea gravel patio using a binding agent to keep stones in place.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S24 E20 — Hang Shades; Steep Landscaping
Installing top-down bottom-up shades to block the outside view for a tiny guard dog; the anatomy of toilet tanks, common failures and how to fix a running toilet; landscaping a steep front yard.

title: This Old House
description:

The renovation of the Westford fire-damaged colonial home is revealed as the crew tours the house.

description:

Five families work to rebuild their lives in the wake of Hurricane Helene.

description:

The builders start putting the homes back together in Asheville; rough-ins begin; meteorologist Stephanie Abrams explains why the storm hit Asheville so hard.

title: This Old House
description:
S47 E03 — Asheville: All Clear
Mark meets with a local mason to investigate the depth of damage caused to a chimney by fallen trees; siding starts to go up at Paula's; Kevin meets with Army Corp to discuss their continued relief efforts.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S13 E23 — Noisy Heat; New Lights
Tom and Kevin discuss kitchen island dimensions; Richard helps a homeowner quiet a noisy baseboard heating system; What Is It?; electrician Scott Caron helps a homeowner add light to a kitchen by installing three new recessed cans.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S13 E24 — Houseplants; US Flag
Roger heads to Maine to help a homeowner plant an indoor tropical garden with plants from Jamaica; Richard demonstrates how to change the temperature on water heaters; Tom and Kevin build an American flag out of reclaimed wood.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S13 E25 — EV Charger; New Sink
Electrician Scott Caron helps a homeowner install an electric vehicle charger next to his house; the guys ask "What Is It?"; Richard helps a homeowner install a new kitchen sink and faucet.

title: Ask This Old House
description:
S13 E26 — Thermostat; Solar
Roger teaches Kevin about lengths to consider when mowing the lawn; Richard installs a thermostat that interfaces with a smartphone to save energy and money; Ross walks Kevin through the installation of a photovoltaic solar array on a barn.
